description: Central registry of all diagram templates. Registered as a singleton DI service. Thread-safe: InitializeAsync runs the catalog load once through a Lazy<Task> (ExecutionAndPublication), concurrent callers all await the same load, and the template dictionary is guarded by a lock.

members.name: GetAll
members.description: Returns all registered templates ordered by Category then Name.

members.name: GetCategories
members.description: Returns all distinct category names in display order.

members.name: GetTemplate
members.description: Returns the template for templateId, or null if not found.

members.name: InitializeAsync
members.description: Initializes the registry by loading all templates from registered providers. Safe to call multiple times (subsequent calls are no-ops).

members.name: RegisterProvider
members.description: Registers a provider for lazy async loading.

members.name: RegisterTemplate
members.description: Registers a single template. If a template with the same id already exists, the one with higher priority wins (ties keep the existing entry).
